name: Rust CLI Template
description: Starter template for Rust CLI applications

files.content:
[package]
name = "{{name}}"
version = "0.1.0"
edition = "2021"
description = "{{description}}"

[[bin]]
name = "{{name}}"
path = "src/main.rs"

[dependencies]
clap = { version = "4.4", features = ["derive"] }
anyhow = "1.0"
